shortDescription: Module for setup of Cloud Avi RESTful Object

options.name: api_context
options.description: Avi API context that includes current session ID and CSRF Token. This allows user to perform single login and re-use the session.

options.name: api_version
options.description: Avi API version of to use for Avi API and objects.

options.name: apic_configuration
options.description: Apicconfiguration settings for cloud.

options.name: apic_mode
options.description: Boolean flag to set apic_mode. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: autoscale_polling_interval
options.description: Cloudconnector polling interval for external autoscale groups. Field introduced in 18.2.2. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 60.

options.name: avi_api_patch_op
options.description: Patch operation to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_api_update_method
options.description: Default method for object update is HTTP PUT. Setting to patch will override that behavior to use HTTP PATCH.

options.name: avi_credentials
options.description: Avi Credentials dictionary which can be used in lieu of enumerating Avi Controller login details.

options.name: avi_disable_session_cache_as_fact
options.displayName: Avi Disable Session Cache As Fact
options.description: It disables avi session information to be cached as a fact.

options.name: aws_configuration
options.description: Awsconfiguration settings for cloud.

options.name: azure_configuration
options.description: Field introduced in 17.2.1.

options.name: cloudstack_configuration
options.description: Cloudstackconfiguration settings for cloud.

options.name: controller
options.description: IP address or hostname of the controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_CONTROLLER).

options.name: custom_tags
options.description: Custom tags for all avi created resources in the cloud infrastructure. Field introduced in 17.1.5.

options.name: dhcp_enabled
options.description: Select the ip address management scheme. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: dns_provider_ref
options.description: Dns profile for the cloud. It is a reference to an object of type ipamdnsproviderprofile.

options.name: docker_configuration
options.description: Dockerconfiguration settings for cloud.

options.name: east_west_dns_provider_ref
options.description: Dns profile for east-west services. It is a reference to an object of type ipamdnsproviderprofile.

options.name: east_west_ipam_provider_ref
options.description: Ipam profile for east-west services. Warning - please use virtual subnets in this ipam profile that do not conflict with the underlay networks or any overlay networks in the cluster. For example in aws and gcp, 169.254.0.0/16 is used for storing instance metadata. Hence, it should not be used in this profile. It is a reference to an object of type ipamdnsproviderprofile.

options.name: enable_vip_static_routes
options.description: Use static routes for vip side network resolution during virtualservice placement. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: gcp_configuration
options.description: Google cloud platform configuration. Field introduced in 18.2.1.

options.name: ip6_autocfg_enabled
options.description: Enable ipv6 auto configuration. Field introduced in 18.1.1. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: ipam_provider_ref
options.description: Ipam profile for the cloud. It is a reference to an object of type ipamdnsproviderprofile.

options.name: license_tier
options.description: Specifies the default license tier which would be used by new se groups. This field by default inherits the value from system configuration. Enum options - ENTERPRISE_16, ENTERPRISE_18. Field introduced in 17.2.5.

options.name: license_type
options.description: If no license type is specified then default license enforcement for the cloud type is chosen. The default mappings are container cloud is max ses, openstack and vmware is cores and linux it is sockets. Enum options - LIC_BACKEND_SERVERS, LIC_SOCKETS, LIC_CORES, LIC_HOSTS, LIC_SE_BANDWIDTH, LIC_METERED_SE_BANDWIDTH.

options.name: linuxserver_configuration
options.description: Linuxserverconfiguration settings for cloud.

options.name: mesos_configuration
options.description: Field deprecated in 18.2.2.

options.name: mtu
options.description: Mtu setting for the cloud. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 1500.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the object.

options.name: nsx_configuration
options.description: Configuration parameters for nsx manager. Field introduced in 17.1.1.

options.name: obj_name_prefix
options.description: Default prefix for all automatically created objects in this cloud. This prefix can be overridden by the se-group template.

options.name: openstack_configuration
options.description: Openstackconfiguration settings for cloud.

options.name: oshiftk8s_configuration
options.description: Oshiftk8sconfiguration settings for cloud.

options.name: password
options.description: Password of Avi user in Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_PASSWORD).

options.name: prefer_static_routes
options.description: Prefer static routes over interface routes during virtualservice placement. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: proxy_configuration
options.description: Proxyconfiguration settings for cloud.

options.name: rancher_configuration
options.description: Rancherconfiguration settings for cloud.

options.name: state
options.description: The state that should be applied on the entity.

options.name: state_based_dns_registration
options.description: Dns records for vips are added/deleted based on the operational state of the vips. Field introduced in 17.1.12. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as True.

options.name: tenant
options.description: Name of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: tenant_ref
options.description: It is a reference to an object of type tenant.

options.name: tenant_uuid
options.description: UUID of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: url
options.description: Avi controller URL of the object.

options.name: username
options.description: Username used for accessing Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_USERNAME).

options.name: uuid
options.description: Unique object identifier of the object.

options.name: vca_configuration
options.description: Vcloudairconfiguration settings for cloud.

options.name: vcenter_configuration
options.description: Vcenterconfiguration settings for cloud.

options.name: vtype
options.description: Cloud type. Enum options - CLOUD_NONE, CLOUD_VCENTER, CLOUD_OPENSTACK, CLOUD_AWS, CLOUD_VCA, CLOUD_APIC, CLOUD_MESOS, CLOUD_LINUXSERVER, CLOUD_DOCKER_UCP, CLOUD_RANCHER, CLOUD_OSHIFT_K8S, CLOUD_AZURE, CLOUD_GCP. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as CLOUD_NONE.
